task_instance: Write a small training script that uses `import trackio` to init a project, log loss/accuracy metrics over 20 steps, fire a diagnostic trackio.alert(), then finish the run; then use the `trackio` CLI to retrieve projects/runs/metrics/alerts as JSON and launch the local dashboard (`trackio show`) to confirm real-time visualization, all running locally without syncing to a Hugging Face Space.
evidence: 1) `pip install trackio` succeeded (trackio-0.39.0). 2) Wrote train.py using trackio.init(project='demo-project', config={'lr':1e-4}), 20 iterations of trackio.log({'loss':..., 'accuracy':..., 'step':...}), a trackio.alert(title='Test alert', level=trackio.AlertLevel.INFO) call, and trackio.finish(). Ran `python train.py` -> printed '* Trackio project initialized: demo-project', '* Created new run: dainty-sunset-0', the alert text '[TRACKIO INFO] Test alert: ...', and 'DONE', with local data stored at /root/.cache/huggingface/trackio (no HF Space/network/credentials needed). 3) Verified retrieval via CLI: `trackio list projects --json` -> {"projects": ["demo-project"]}; `trackio list runs --project demo-project --json` -> run 'dainty-sunset-0'; `trackio list metrics --project demo-project --run dainty-sunset-0 --json` -> ['__step','accuracy','loss']; `trackio get metric --project demo-project --run dainty-sunset-0 --metric loss --json` returned all 20 logged (step, value, timestamp) records matching the exponential decay computed in the script; `trackio list alerts --project demo-project --json` returned the fired 'Test alert' with level 'info' and correct text/step. 4) Verified dashboard: ran `trackio show --project demo-project` in background, it printed 'Trackio UI launched at http://127.0.0.1:7860/...' and `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}'` against that URL returned 200. All three interfaces described in SKILL.md (Python logging API, alerts API, CLI retrieval with --json) were exercised end-to-end and verified locally; HF Space syncing was intentionally not attempted since it needs an HF account/token, but the skill's core deliverable (logging, alerting, retrieving, and visualizing metrics) works fully without it.
